title: feat(metadata-admin): friendlier + safer dataset measure authoring
body:
## Summary

Polishes the `dataset` designer (`DatasetDefaultInspector`) so a business user can author measures without spec knowledge and without saving a broken dataset. Found while dogfooding online dataset design in Studio.

| Improvement | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| **Display-format picker** | Raw `format` / `currency` numeral text inputs (`$0,0.00`, `USD`) | Kind (Raw / Number / Currency / Percent) + Decimals + Currency selects **+ live sample** (`US$1,234.50`); parses an existing format back into the picker |
| **Auto-name from field** | Name typed by hand | Picking a field on an unnamed dimension/measure defaults the name to the field's leaf (`account.region` → `region`) |
| **Author-time validation** | A `relationship.field` whose join isn't in `include` only failed when the **preview query ran** (compile error / ambiguous join) | Inline warning + one-click **"Add it"** on the offending dimension/measure; derived measures with too few operands flagged too |

### Why
A semantic-layer author shouldn't need to know numeral syntax, and the "relationship not declared in `include`" error should surface at design time, not as a failed query. These are the gaps left after the inspector already gained derived-measure editing, the field catalog (relationship cascade), certified, and the binding banner.

### Verification
- `DatasetDefaultInspector.test.tsx`: **9 pass** (+2 new — relationship warning + "Add it"; format picker replaces the raw field).
- metadata-admin **inspectors sweep: 97 pass**.
- **Browser-verified** in showcase Studio (console rebuilt + vendored): the budget measure's stored `format: '0,0.00'` + `currency: 'USD'` parses to **Currency · Decimals 2 · USD ($)** with **Sample: US$1,234.50**; removing the `account` join surfaces **"⚠ Relationship account isn't in Included relationships · Add it"** on the `account.name` dimension.

### Scope / follow-ups (not in this PR)
- Routing dataset **create** to this designer (canvas-create, `CREATE_MODE_CANVAS_TYPES`) — overlaps the in-flight report-create work; should land with it.
- Preview **mixed-scale** axis (a ratio measure plotted next to a currency measure is invisible) — needs a secondary Y axis in `plugin-charts`.
